name: Swami Vivekananda Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Class 11th & 12th)
benefit:
- Under this scheme, the girl student will get a scholarship of ₹550/- per year and boy student will get a scholarship of ₹500/- per year.

**Note:** The scholarship is sent directly to the student&#39;s bank account.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
   1. The applicant should be studying in Class 11 or Class 12.
   1. The student should be enrolled in a government school.
   1. Students studying in Class 11 must have passed their 10th board examination with a first division, and students studying in Class 12 must have passed their Class 11 examination with a first division to be eligible for this scholarship.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
   1. The applicant&#39;s parents&#39; income from all sources should be less than ₹1,00,000/- per year.
